How we know

For visitors

Park behind the lodge, not in front of the lodge or guest rooms. The calendar listing points to the Buffalo Lodge Bike Tribe on Meetup. Old Town Bike Shop's page says the Manitou Spokes also leave from here on Saturdays, at 10 am in winter and 8:30 am in summer.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 10:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Blue/Black and Blue guided groups, or show-and-go. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Buffalo Lodge Saturday Group Ride group ride

Buffalo Lodge Saturday Group Ride is a road group ride in Colorado Springs, CO. It rolls every Saturday at 10:00 am from Buffalo Lodge Bicycle Resort (park in back).

A resort ride from the Buffalo Lodge that is also an official ride of the Colorado Springs Cycling Club. Two guided groups run when there are volunteers: Blue/Black for riders who want to push, and Blue for a medium-pace exercise ride. Without leaders it is a show-and-go. Lasts about 3 hours.
